main_text.p: פִּיס Pahel Ch. Placare, sedare, persuadere, placatum, securum, contentum reddere: Item Supplicare, petere, precari, obsecrare, rogare: Aphel אַפִּיס Ch.&Syr.Idem. Ithpahel אִתְפִּיס Placari, sedari, reconciliari.
ܦܝܣܐ Syr. Persuasus, certus. Plur. ܦܝܣܝܢ.
פִּיּוּס Ch. Persuasio. Plural. וּמַלֵּל פִּיּוּסִין עַל לִבָּא דִרְיבָא Et locutus est persuasiones, id est, blanda, persuasoria verba ad cor puellae, Genef.34.3. in Jonath. Graec. πεισμοὶ λόγοι.
פִּיסָא פִּיס Ch. Syr. ܦܝܣܐ. Vide in פסס.
פִּסְיָאִירִת Ch.Apposite, opportune, Prov.25.11. Respondet Hebraeo עַל אַפַּנְיו.
פְּכָה פְּבָה Syr. Infatuari, Insipidum reddi, Matthaei 5.13. Mar.9.49. & Lucae 14.34.
ܦܒܐ Syr. Insipidus. Foemin. ܠܦܒܐ ܠܙ Ficus insipida, sylvestris, Sycomorus, Lucae 19.4.
פָּכַךְ Ithpeh. אִתְפָּכַךְ Ch. Teneri, cōtineri, Prov.5.22.

page.notes: Several lines contain Syriac and Hebrew/Aramaic type that could not be fully verified letter by letter; Syriac forms are approximate. Greek phrase at "Graec." is approximate. Marginal notes at the left and right margins are faint show-through and were not transcribed.
